title: ReAct: reasoning and acting with tools

videos.script: A customer was served four cold soups, and wants the money back. {{soup}} How much is it, and does somebody have to approve it? {{question}} A model asked on its own will answer from what usually comes next. It might be right. Nothing on the screen would tell you. {{guess}} ReAct is a way of making the model show its working and check its facts. {{name}} It writes a thought, then an action: a tool, and what to ask it. {{action}} The program around it runs the tool and writes back what came out. That is the observation. {{observation}} Then the model thinks again, with the observation in front of it. {{again}} Thought, action, observation, as many times as it takes, then an answer. {{answer}} In this lesson you read a full run, step by step, against the café's handbook and a calculator. {{run}} Then you break it five ways, and see which failures the loop catches and which it cannot. {{break}}
